clue.text: Talk about the right get-up

indicators.note: about means the word for talk goes round the other piece

parts.note: gab is idle chatter or talk
R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone holds forth on the correct outfit to wear.
explanation.definitionFit: A get-up is an outfit or costume, which is what garb means: clothing of a distinctive kind.

clue.text: A gem ring given to a mate

parts.note: a ring is round, so it stands for the letter O
a mate is a friend or pal

explanation.surface: A jewelled ring is presented to a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is an iridescent precious stone, one kind of gem.

clue.text: Above the church in days gone by

parts.note: on means resting on top of, above
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A remark about what used to be built over the church long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Once as an adverb means formerly, at some time in the past.

clue.text: It's quite true about 6's correction

indicators.note: about means the word for true goes round the other piece

parts.note: something quite true is real
6 in Roman numerals is VI, and the 's adds an S

explanation.surface: Someone confirms that the editing of another clue's answer was accurate.
explanation.walkthrough: '6's' looks like a cross-reference to another clue, but it is the Roman numeral VI with its 's, VIS, placed inside REAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A revisal is a revision, the act of going over something again to put it right.

clue.text: He wants to dispose of the lot!

definitions.text: He wants to dispose of the lot!

parts.words: He wants to dispose of the lot!
parts.note: reads like someone desperate to get rid of everything, but a lot is an item put up for sale in a saleroom, which this person sells to the highest bidder

explanation.definitionFit: The person running a sale knocks down each lot in turn, getting rid of items to bidders.

clue.text: After censure gets in tradesmen

parts.note: to carp is to find fault or censure
enters means goes in, gets in

explanation.surface: Following a telling-off, some workmen are let into the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Carpenters are skilled woodworkers, one kind of tradesmen.

clue.text: Jaded fellow causing deadlock

parts.note: stale means jaded or tired
a mate is a fellow or companion

explanation.surface: A tired chap is responsible for negotiations grinding to a halt.
explanation.walkthrough: STALEMATE is the chess position where neither side can win, hence any deadlock.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalemate is a situation in which no progress can be made, an impasse.

clue.text: A guest's endless complaint

indicators.note: endless says the tail of the word for a visitor is cut off

parts.note: the word guest, the possessive giving no letter

explanation.surface: A visitor keeps grumbling without stopping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' here removes the final ST of GUEST to leave GUE.
explanation.definitionFit: An ague is a fever with shivering, a complaint in the sense of an illness.

clue.text: Alsatians dealt with the man committing an assault

indicators.note: dealt with suggests the letters of the dog breed are handled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Some guard dogs were set on a man who attacked someone.
explanation.definitionFit: An assailant is an attacker, a person who assaults another.

clue.text: The dancer in an Irish night-club all Erin admires

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: An Irish nightclub hosts a performer whom everyone in Ireland adores.
explanation.walkthrough: Erin is a poetic name for Ireland, fitting the Irish surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballerina is a female ballet dancer.

clue.text: The trainee a leading journalist guided

parts.note: L is for learner, as on a learner driver's plate
ED is short for editor, the leading journalist on a paper

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor shows a novice reporter the ropes.
explanation.definitionFit: Led is the past tense of lead, meaning showed the way or guided.

clue.text: Cooked teas give complete satisfaction

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are prepared afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: Well-prepared afternoon teas leave everyone thoroughly content.
explanation.definitionFit: To sate is to satisfy an appetite fully, even to excess.

clue.text: The European with a stretch of pastureland

parts.note: le is the French for the, a European article

explanation.surface: A Continental tourist strolls across a piece of meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: A lea is a poetic word for an open meadow or grassland.

clue.text: A work of art presented by the head of state?

parts.note: a land is a state or country, here with its possessive
a head is a headland, also called a cape

explanation.surface: A painting given as a gift by a president or monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of state' looks like a ruler, but it is read as a cape belonging to a land: LAND'S CAPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A landscape is a painting depicting scenery, a common genre of artwork.

clue.text: The manufacturers test longer handled glasses

indicators.note: the manufacturers make something new, so the following letters are reworked into another order

explanation.surface: Factory staff put a longer product through its trials.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorgnettes are spectacles held up to the eyes by a long handle.

clue.text: Made observations about the talking bird selected

indicators.note: about means the word for remarked goes round the bird

parts.note: noted means remarked or made observations
the mina, or myna, is a bird that mimics speech

explanation.surface: Someone commented on a parrot-like bird that had been picked out.
explanation.definitionFit: Nominated means put forward or chosen for a role.

clue.text: They look for viewers without cunning

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the viewers enclose the other piece

parts.note: seers are those who see, viewers
arch means sly or cunning

explanation.surface: Honest people seek spectators who have no guile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but it means outside here.
explanation.definitionFit: Searchers are people who seek or hunt for something.

clue.text: Press for a golf club

definitions.meaning: to press clothes is to smooth them flat with a hot appliance
a club with an angled metal head used for approach shots

explanation.definitionFit: The same word covers smoothing laundry and a metal-headed club in golf.

clue.text: Somehow cram into a seaman's transport

indicators.note: into says the shuffled piece goes inside the sailor

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor or seaman

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of the next word are muddled

explanation.surface: Someone manages to squeeze into a sailor's vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' turns CRAM into RAMC, which goes into TAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramcar is a passenger vehicle on rails, a form of public transport.

clue.text: Tom has bare midriff — all for show

indicators.note: midriff says the next word sits in the middle of the word for the animal

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: A man named Tom exposes his stomach purely to be seen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a man's name, but it is a male cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabaret is entertainment staged in a nightclub or restaurant, a kind of show.

clue.text: Evil framing supporter, a criminal

indicators.note: framing means the word for evil goes round the following pieces

parts.note: ill can mean evil, as in ill deeds
a leg supports a table or body

explanation.surface: A wicked person stitches up a backer, a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: Illegal means against the law, which is what criminal also means.

clue.text: Article about unknown writer

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
on means concerning, about

explanation.surface: A piece concerning an author no one can identify.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is short for anonymous, the label given to an author whose name is not known.

clue.text: An individual saving company money for reader

parts.note: L stands for the pound, from Latin libra
a lector is one who reads aloud, especially in church

explanation.surface: Someone who puts aside a firm's cash to pass to a reader.
explanation.definitionFit: A collector is someone who gathers and keeps things, accumulating rather than spending.

clue.text: Irish constables backed up this ne'er-do-well

indicators.note: backed up in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: RUC is the Royal Ulster Constabulary, the old Northern Ireland police

explanation.surface: Police officers in Ulster supported a good-for-nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A cur is a mongrel dog, and by extension a contemptible or worthless person.

clue.text: Refuse to make a request for silence

parts.note: sh is the sound made to ask for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone declines to ask for quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb, but it is the noun meaning rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is the residue left after burning, a kind of waste or rubbish.

clue.text: Some taste their food and let it stand

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few diners try their meal and leave it on the table.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'food and', but STET means only 'let it stand'; 'food and' is surface padding between the hidden run and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Stet is the proofreader's instruction, Latin for let it remain, telling the printer to keep a deleted word.

clue.text: Regards exercise as a personal problem

parts.note: to regard is to look at, and eyes as a verb means looks at
to train is to exercise or drill

explanation.surface: Someone thinks of working out as a private difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyestrain is fatigue of the eyes, an ailment affecting the individual sufferer.

clue.text: Carry a child one way

parts.note: a tot is a small child
E for east is one compass direction

explanation.surface: Instruction to hold a youngster in one particular manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to carry or lug something about.

clue.text: Some land requires exceptional care

indicators.note: exceptional suggests the letters of the next word are out of the ordinary order

explanation.surface: A plot of ground needs special attention.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit of area, so it names a measured piece of ground.

clue.text: Such a figure could make one cross!

definitions.text: Such a figure could make one cross!

parts.words: Such a figure could make one cross!
parts.note: reads as a number that annoys someone, but in Roman numerals I (one) placed before X (a cross) makes this number

explanation.definitionFit: In Roman numerals IX, a one before a cross shape, denotes this digit.

clue.text: Lean nurse

definitions.meaning: to incline or have a tendency towards
to look after or care for someone

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to incline towards something and to care for a patient.

clue.text: Straighten out when cracking up

indicators.note: out says the letters of the previous word are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone tries to sort themselves out while having a breakdown.
explanation.definitionFit: Shattering means breaking into pieces, as something cracking up does.
